positions.name: SignedManifestGateAsMandate
positions.frame: Is the signed-manifest requirement being enacted here as a positional, authority-backed mandate — whether spoken directive or memo record — rather than as an argument being made for it?
positions.why: Across relational, power, and conviction reads, src-1 (Quinton's verbal directive), src-3 (Gate field), src-4 (Scope field), and src-5 (Owner field) all land as authority-ranking / legitimate-pressure / decision performances — the gate is *declared*, not debated, whether spoken or codified in the memo's bolded-label format. src-2 stands apart in every one of these dimensional reads (market-pricing/rational-persuasion/claim rather than authority-ranking/legitimate/decision) — it argues *for* the gate via cited incident rather than enacting it, so it does not join this mandate-performance group despite sharing the topic.
